15.L150:
<n>150:1</n> Laudáte Dóminum in sanctis ejus: * laudáte eum in firmaménto virtútis ejus.
<n>150:2</n> Laudáte eum in virtútibus ejus: * laudáte eum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis ejus.
<n>150:3</n> Laudáte eum in sono tubæ: * laudáte eum in psaltério, et cíthara.
<n>150:4</n> Laudáte eum in týmpano, et choro: * laudáte eum in chordis, et órgano.
<n>150:5</n> Laudáte eum in cýmbalis benesonántibus: † laudáte eum in cýmbalis jubilatiónis: * (6) omnis spíritus laudet Dóminum.
15.E150:
<n>150:1</n> Praise ye the Lord in his holy places: * praise ye him in the firmament of his power.
<n>150:2</n> Praise ye him for his mighty acts: * praise ye him according to the multitude of his greatness.
<n>150:3</n> Praise him with sound of trumpet: * praise him with psaltery and harp.
<n>150:4</n> Praise him with timbrel and choir: * praise him with strings and organs.
<n>150:5</n> Praise him on high sounding cymbals: † praise him on cymbals of joy: * (6) let every spirit praise the Lord.
